ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure is a circuit with a 555 timer as the core. Pin 8 of the 555 chip is connected to +UDD, and pin 1 is grounded; the reset terminal of pin 4 is connected to the high level of the power supply; the control terminal of pin 5 is grounded through C0, marked as 0.01 μF; pin 3 leads out the output uo. On the left side there is an external timing resistor R connected from +UDD to an RC node, and capacitor C is connected from this node to ground; this RC node is connected to the threshold terminal TH of pin 6 and the discharge terminal D of pin 7. The input ui enters the trigger terminal TR of pin 2 from the left side. Reasoning: This connection mode is consistent with the monostable application circuit of the 555: after the external trigger pulse is applied to pin 2, the 555 output enters a quasi-stable state, while the timing capacitor C charges through R; when the capacitor voltage reaches the comparison level of the threshold terminal, the internal trigger resets, the output returns to the original state, and the discharge terminal causes the capacitor to discharge. This circuit produces only one output pulse of a certain width for one trigger, therefore what is implemented is the monostable trigger function.

method.method_draft: First describe the figure as a 555 timer circuit with an external timing resistor R and capacitor C, trigger input ui entering pin 2, threshold/discharge pins associated with the RC timing node, reset pin 4 tied to the supply, control pin 5 decoupled, and output taken from pin 3. Then compare these connections with the standard 555 application circuits: a trigger pulse on pin 2 starts charging the timing capacitor through R until the threshold comparator resets the output, giving a single temporary output state. Therefore the implemented function is a monostable trigger.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图中是一个以 555 定时器为核心的电路。555 芯片的 8 脚接到 +UDD，1 脚接地；4 脚复位端接到电源高电平；5 脚控制端通过 C0 接地，标注为 0.01 μF；3 脚引出输出 uo。左侧有外接定时电阻 R 从 +UDD 接到一个 RC 节点，电容 C 从该节点接地；该 RC 节点与 6 脚 TH 阈值端和 7 脚 D 放电端相连。输入 ui 从左侧进入 2 脚 TR 触发端。推理：这种连接方式与 555 的单稳态应用电路一致：外部触发脉冲加到 2 脚后，555 输出进入暂稳态，同时定时电容 C 通过 R 充电；当电容电压达到阈值端的比较电平后，内部触发器复位，输出恢复原状态，放电端使电容放电。该电路对一次触发只产生一个一定宽度的输出脉冲，因此实现的是单稳态触发功能。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the 555 IC pins and wiring from the diagram: pin 8 to +UDD, pin 1 to ground, pin 4 reset held high, pin 5 bypassed by C0=0.01 μF, output uo at pin 3, input ui applied to trigger pin 2, and an external R-C network with R to +UDD and C to ground connected to threshold pin 6 and discharge pin 7.
planner_metadata.text_role: Read the question text to know it asks for the function implemented by the circuit composed of the 555 integrated chip.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard 555 timer configuration rules: when pins 6 and 7 share an RC timing node, pin 2 receives an external trigger pulse, reset is tied high, and pin 3 is the output, the circuit produces one timed output pulse per trigger; this is a monostable multivibrator/monostable trigger.
